download_model_from_url: download a PyTorch model checkpoint from a URL and cache it locally
cache_model_with_custom_dir: cache a model file to a custom directory using cache_url with model_dir
cache_model_without_progress: download a model checkpoint silently by setting progress to False
review_cache_url_function: review the cache_url function that downloads and caches Torch serialized model files
summarize_model_zoo_module: summarize the model_zoo module that provides URL caching with hash verification for model files
